implementation_resolutions.decision: Keep owner-created scoped personal access tokens on REST and require OAuth 2.1 discovery, PKCE, consent, audience/resource binding, short-lived access tokens, rotation, and revocation for remote MCP. PAT-only remote MCP and downstream token passthrough are prohibited.
implementation_resolutions.scope_effect: No product capability is added; this selects the standards-compatible authorization mechanism required to deliver the already accepted PM-only remote MCP scope.

implementation_resolutions.decision: Serve the existing Vite SPA with Firebase Hosting and rewrite trusted API, MCP, and OAuth traffic to Cloud Run/Functions instead of converting the app to Next.js/Angular or relying on an unsupported App Hosting adapter.
implementation_resolutions.scope_effect: The product remains Firebase-hosted with Firestore authority; this removes an unsupported deployment assumption without adding product scope.

issues.title: Instrument hosted outcomes, audit sources, and cost baselines

output: A versioned event, audit, and cost-measurement contract covers all four outcome baselines.
quality: Event identity, provenance, privacy, and reconciliation fixtures pass without double counting.
outcome: Baseline tasks can produce reviewable O-201 through O-204 evidence without claiming success early.

issues.title: Deliver Firebase hosting, Google sign-in, and idempotent trial bootstrap

output: A hosted Firebase entry point, Google authentication flow, and transactional first-owner bootstrap are available.
quality: Auth, retry, concurrency, timezone, local-authority separation, and excluded-surface checks pass.
outcome: Eligible owners can enter a measurable hosted activation and trial journey.

issues.title: Enforce workspace isolation and owner/member authorization

output: Owner/member authorization is enforced at Firestore and trusted server boundaries.
quality: The complete role and cross-workspace adversarial matrix has zero unauthorized successful operations.
outcome: Collaboration and automation can operate on a trustworthy workspace-scoped authority.

output: Owners can send, inspect, revoke, and safely accept email-bound invitations.
quality: Expiry, replay, enumeration, duplicate acceptance, role, audit, and accessibility tests pass.
outcome: A workspace can enter the measurable owner-to-member collaboration loop.

issues.title: Add single-assignee tasks and durable comments

output: Issues support one active same-workspace assignee and durable authored comment history.
quality: Permission, revision, retry, soft-delete, ordering, activity, and accessibility tests pass.
outcome: Members can complete the assigned-work and comment actions measured by O-202.

issues.title: Add 30-day Pro trial, per-seat subscriptions, and Free fallback

output: Server-owned trial, monthly/annual checkout, seat quantity, entitlement, and one-writer Free fallback states are available.
quality: Price, proration, webhook replay/order, expiry, downgrade, data preservation, budget, and copy tests pass.
outcome: Eligible owners can make a measurable trial-to-paid choice at the sponsor-confirmed prices.

issues.title: Publish the scoped PM REST API, token lifecycle, and workspace export

output: A versioned OpenAPI 3.1.1 PM API, scoped token lifecycle, and workspace export are published.
quality: Schema, authorization, pagination, idempotency, revision, audit, redaction, revocation, and leakage tests pass.
outcome: Canonical product-management operations are available for deterministic REST measurement.

issues.title: Expose PM-only MCP tools and the reusable skill

output: Streamable HTTP MCP tools and an openlinear-product-management skill expose the bounded PM operation map.
quality: Protocol, schema, API parity, cancellation, authorization, audit, and prohibited-capability scans pass.
outcome: Canonical product-management operations are available for deterministic MCP measurement.

issues.title: Establish hosted operations, abuse, security, and cost controls

output: Budgets, limits, operational telemetry, abuse defenses, incident procedures, and cost-per-paid-seat reporting are configured.
quality: Configuration review, boundary security suite, rate-limit load test, restore drill, and billing reconciliation pass.
outcome: The price and automation surfaces have reviewable safety and unit-economics guardrail evidence.

output: The integrated acceptance matrix covers owner, member, billing, REST, MCP, export, accessibility, security, and exclusions.
quality: Every required scenario has durable evidence and all release-blocking defects are resolved or explicitly stopped.
outcome: A candidate can enter independent Testing while all four outcome baselines and success claims remain pending.
